run_geometry_optimization: run a geometry optimization job on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator and optimization flags
run_single_point_energy: run a single-point energy and force calculation on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator
run_conformer_energies: run geometry optimizations on molecular conformers and return initial and final energy and force results
run_protonation_energies: run protonation state energy and geometry calculations across multiple protonation states of molecules
run_spin_gap: run single-point calculations on structures at different spin states to evaluate spin gap energies
